text:
The MGAP national forest cartography (2021 version) is the source that classifies the 2025 loss area as native forest. It maps 13.1 ha of the event area as native forest, 0.0 ha as planted forest, and 0.4 ha as outside mapped forest.

The other sources do not make this distinction:
- Hansen GFC (GFC-2025-v1.13) only detects the 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss in 2025, which is 3.91% of the asset. It does not classify forest type.
- JRC GFC2020 V4 shows that 98% of the event area was forest in 2020, but it does not separate native from planted forest.

The MGAP map dates from 2021, so it describes forest type before the 2025 loss rather than after it.
